'''Veghash''' was a common vegetable dish served on the side in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]]. It was made of a [[soypro]]-based meat substitute, a shell of grain and [[choya]], and seasoning, all mashed together. Some beings were reminded of the importance of meat after eating this dish. [[Vegeparsine]] was an even more elaborate version.

==Behind the scenes==
VegHash was first mentioned in the [[West End Games]] adventure ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', and was also mentioned in the ''[[Smuggler's Log]]'' section of [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 4|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 4]]. When VegHash made its appearance in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', the name was written as "Veghash" without capitalizing the "H."
